# Archerlab Games
> Free browser-based web game portal — play instantly, no download needed.

## About
Archerlab Games is a web game portal where you can play various casual games directly in the browser. All games are free and require no installation.

## Games
- [Lumen Shift](https://game.archerlab.dev/lumen-shift/): Music-reactive falling-block puzzle ([English](https://game.archerlab.dev/lumen-shift/index-en))
- [Jelly Pang 2048](https://game.archerlab.dev/jelly-pang-2048/): Jelly merge puzzle ([English](https://game.archerlab.dev/jelly-pang-2048/index-en))
- [Parking Escape](https://game.archerlab.dev/parking-escape/): Sliding-car parking puzzle ([English](https://game.archerlab.dev/parking-escape/index-en))
- [Jewelria](https://game.archerlab.dev/jewelria/): Match-3 jewel puzzle ([English](https://game.archerlab.dev/jewelria/index-en))
- [School Zombie Defense](https://game.archerlab.dev/school-zombie-defense/): Vertical zombie defense game ([English](https://game.archerlab.dev/school-zombie-defense/index-en))
- [BlockPang](https://game.archerlab.dev/blockpang/): Block placement puzzle ([English](https://game.archerlab.dev/blockpang/index-en))
- [Shadow Survival](https://game.archerlab.dev/solo-leveling/): 2D dungeon survival game ([English](https://game.archerlab.dev/solo-leveling/index-en))
- [Cat Tower](https://game.archerlab.dev/cat-tower/): Physics-based cat merge puzzle ([English](https://game.archerlab.dev/cat-tower/index-en))
- [Slime Volley](https://game.archerlab.dev/slimevolley/): Browser volleyball game ([English](https://game.archerlab.dev/slimevolley/index-en))
- [Bubbly Lab (보글보글 실험실)](https://game.archerlab.dev/water-sort/): Potion color-sorting puzzle with 60-second stages ([English](https://game.archerlab.dev/water-sort/index-en))

## Features
- 100% browser-based — no download or install
- Mobile and desktop support
- Free to play

- Korean (한국어) and English. Each game has a Korean page and an English page. Guides exist in both languages.
